channel.title: Lineup Confirmed
channel.description: Lineup Confirmed tracks who is starting today across sports: NHL starting goalies, MLB probable pitchers and closers, NBA injury status, Premier League lineups and NFL starting quarterbacks. Every starter is labeled expected or confirmed and linked to its source.

item.title: Dustin Wolf Starts for the Flames Against Seattle After Devin Cooley's Lower-Body Injury
item.description: Dustin Wolf gets his first start since Oct. 15 when Calgary hosts Seattle on Friday. Devin Cooley is out after a crease collision at Edmonton, and the Flames recalled Arsenii Sergeev.

item.title: How NHL Starting Goalies Get Confirmed on Game Day
item.description: Confirmed, expected or unconfirmed: what each label on our NHL starting goalie board means, and the game-day steps that move a goalie from one to the next.

item.title: Pyotr Kochetkov Wins His Ninth Straight Start to Open the Season, a Hurricanes Record
item.description: Kochetkov made 24 saves in a 3-2 win over Columbus and is 9-0-0, passing Frederik Andersen's franchise mark of eight wins to open a season. Carolina's next game is Sunday against Winnipeg.

item.title: Philipp Grubauer Expected in Goal Again as the Kraken Visit Calgary
item.description: Seattle's morning skate pointed to Philipp Grubauer for a second straight start Friday at Calgary, where Dustin Wolf is confirmed for the Flames. Grubauer is expected, not confirmed.

item.title: Saturday Afternoon NHL Goalies: Luukkonen Projected at LA, Johansson Listed After Thursday's Pull
item.description: NHL.com's projected lineups are out for Saturday's six afternoon games. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is listed for Buffalo at Los Angeles and Jonas Johansson for Ottawa at San Jose. All are projections, not confirmations.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Saturday, Oct. 31, 2026: Flames on a Back-to-Back, Jarry and Sorokin Projected
item.description: Saturday has 10 NHL games starting at 1 p.m. ET. Calgary is the only team on the second night of a back-to-back, and NHL.com projects Tristan Jarry and Ilya Sorokin for Oilers at Islanders.

item.title: Akira Schmid Starts for the Panthers Against Winnipeg, and Nico Daws Is Expected for the Jets
item.description: Paul Maurice named Akira Schmid for Friday's home game against the Jets. NHL.com projects Nico Daws for Winnipeg, a day after he relieved Stuart Skinner in a 6-4 loss at Tampa Bay.

item.title: Jakub Dobes Will Start for the Canadiens Against Dallas on Thursday
item.description: Martin St. Louis confirmed Jakub Dobes starts Thursday at Dallas after Fowler's 46-save shutout. The Stars' goalie is not in that note or the status report.

item.title: Logan Thompson Returns and Starts, Making 23 Saves in the Capitals' 5-2 Win Over the Flyers
item.description: Logan Thompson made 23 saves in his return from injured reserve as Washington beat Philadelphia 5-2. Joseph Woll started. No Nashville starter is named.

item.title: What an NHL Back-to-Back Changes About the Starting Goalie
item.description: The second night of a back-to-back is its own starter decision. Flyers, Devils and Capitals show when that decision is confirmed and when it is still open.

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck Starts His Devils Debut at Dallas: 'He Is Going Tonight'
item.description: Sheldon Keefe confirmed Connor Hellebuyck starts Tuesday at Dallas, four days after the trade from Winnipeg. Casey DeSmith starts for the Stars. New Jersey plays at Colorado on Wednesday.

item.title: Dan Vladar Starts for the Flyers Against Columbus, With a Back-to-Back in Washington Next
item.description: Rick Tocchet confirmed Dan Vladar will start Tuesday against Cam Talbot and the Blue Jackets. Philadelphia plays at Washington on Wednesday, and no starter has been named for that game.

item.title: Adin Hill Starts for Vegas Against Ottawa After Carter Hart Is Hurt at the Morning Skate
item.description: Carter Hart was injured at Vegas' morning skate and is being evaluated, NHL.com reports, so Adin Hill starts Tuesday against Ottawa. Jonas Johansson starts for the Senators.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026: Capitals on a Back-to-Back, Red Wings' Postava Question
item.description: Thursday has 11 NHL games and no starters reported yet. Washington is on the second night of a back-to-back, and Detroit has not said whether Michal Postava keeps the net.

item.title: Rangers Pull James Reimer After One Period of His Debut; Dylan Garand's Workload Stays the Story
item.description: James Reimer allowed three goals on eight shots in his first Rangers start and was replaced by Dylan Garand in a 6-3 loss to the Kings. Mike Sullivan took the blame. New York does not play again until Sunday.

item.title: Michal Postava Wins His First NHL Start, Stopping McDavid, Draisaitl and Nugent-Hopkins in the Shootout
item.description: Red Wings rookie Michal Postava made 25 saves and went 3-for-3 in the shootout in a 4-3 win at Edmonton. Detroit hosts Chicago on Thursday, and the team has not said who starts.

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck Says He Is Ready for His Devils Debut; Tuesday Starter at Dallas Not Named
item.description: Connor Hellebuyck practiced with New Jersey for the first time Monday and said he could play today. Coach Sheldon Keefe wants him involved on the three-game trip but is taking it day by day.

item.title: Flames' Devin Cooley Has Started Three Straight Wins Before Maple Leafs Visit
item.description: Devin Cooley has started each of Calgary's three straight wins ahead of Monday's game with Toronto. Here is where both creases stand before any starter is announced.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026: Hellebuyck Debuts, Adin Hill In for Vegas
item.description: All 22 Tuesday starters are now reported: 12 confirmed and 10 expected. Connor Hellebuyck debuts for New Jersey, and Adin Hill starts for Vegas after Carter Hart was hurt at the morning skate.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Wednesday, Oct. 28: Logan Thompson Probable for Capitals; Devils on a Back-to-Back
item.description: Wednesday has four NHL games and no announced starters yet. NHL.com lists Capitals goalie Logan Thompson as probable to return, and New Jersey plays the second half of a back-to-back at Colorado.

item.title: Oilers Goalies Without Devon Levi: Tristan Jarry and Matt Tomkins Before Red Wings Game
item.description: With Devon Levi on injured reserve, Edmonton has Tristan Jarry and recalled Matt Tomkins for Monday's game against Detroit. Neither team has named a starter yet.

item.title: Rangers Add James Reimer as Dylan Garand's Workload Grows Before Kings Game
item.description: The Rangers signed 38-year-old James Reimer on Sunday, a day before hosting the Kings. Here is what is known about Monday's crease and what has not been announced.

item.title: Red Wings Turn to Michal Postava for His First NHL Start at Edmonton; Jarry in Goal for Oilers
item.description: Detroit coach Todd McLellan named 24-year-old Michal Postava as Monday's starter at Edmonton, his first NHL start. The Oilers announced Tristan Jarry for the home side.

item.title: Canucks Project Leevi Merilainen vs. Wild as Quinn Hughes Returns, Oct. 25, 2026
item.description: Leevi Merilainen is projected to start for Vancouver against Minnesota on Sunday after Kevin Lankinen played Thursday. Calvin Pickard is confirmed for the Wild.

item.title: Islanders Expect Ilya Sorokin vs. Jake Oettinger in Dallas, Oct. 25, 2026
item.description: The Islanders' own game preview says Ilya Sorokin is expected to start at Dallas on Sunday, against an expected Jake Oettinger. Neither start had been officially confirmed when we published.

item.title: Jets Goalie for Heritage Classic: Skinner or Stevenson After Hellebuyck Trade; Canadiens Starter Not Announced
item.description: Winnipeg plays its first game since trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson as its two NHL goalies. Neither the Jets nor the Canadiens had confirmed a Heritage Classic starter in the sources we checked.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Monday, Oct. 26, 2026: Kings-Rangers, Leafs-Flames, Red Wings-Oilers
item.description: Monday evening update: James Reimer, Sergei Bobrovsky, Devin Cooley, Michal Postava and Tristan Jarry are confirmed, and Darcy Kuemper is expected for the Kings.

item.title: NHL Starting Goalies Tonight (Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026): Schmid, Knight and Pickard Confirmed; Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner Expected
item.description: Five NHL games Sunday. Akira Schmid and Spencer Knight started in Chicago, and Calvin Pickard is confirmed for Minnesota. Sorokin, Oettinger, Fowler, Skinner, Wedgewood, Annunen and Merilainen are expected.

item.title: Panthers Confirm Akira Schmid in Goal at Blackhawks Tonight; Blackhawks Expected to Turn to Soderblom
item.description: Florida confirms Akira Schmid starts Sunday at Chicago with Jacob Markstrom injured. NHL.com projects Arvid Soderblom for Chicago after Spencer Knight's five straight starts.

item.title: Predators Close Back-to-Back vs. Avalanche After Saros' 34-Save Night in Pittsburgh
item.description: Nashville hosts Colorado on the second night of a back-to-back after Juuse Saros played Saturday in Pittsburgh, and the team is skipping its morning skate. Neither club has confirmed a starter.

item.title: Wild Confirm Calvin Pickard Starts at Canucks Tonight on Back-to-Back
item.description: Minnesota coach John Hynes split the weekend back-to-back: Jesper Wallstedt started Saturday at Seattle and Calvin Pickard starts Sunday in Vancouver. The Canucks have not confirmed their goalie.
